name: Laya RAG router sample v1
description: Questions for the RAG router, written for this demo. Each has the route that should handle it and, for knowledge questions, whether the answer is in that knowledge base (with the verbatim evidence span when it is). Knowledge-base questions are about the fictional documents in corpus.json.

routes.name: Encyclopedia RAG
routes.description: Encyclopedia articles: history of places, landmarks, buildings, people, food and nature
routes.note: Dense retrieval (MiniLM cosine) over encyclopedia passages

routes.name: News RAG
routes.description: News reports: recent events, local politics, company results, storms, studies, sport and health services
routes.note: Dense retrieval (MiniLM cosine) over news passages

routes.name: Policy RAG
routes.description: Policies and documentation: rules, terms, returns, leave, insurance cover, API limits, library and house rules
routes.note: Hybrid retrieval: MiniLM cosine plus BM25 keywords, because exact terms and numbers matter in policy text

routes.name: No retrieval
routes.description: Not a question about our documents: small talk, maths, jokes, writing or coding help
routes.note: Nothing to look up: the assistant answers directly or declines
